item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) -- Just days shy of his birthday, 58-year-old Steve Smith was arriving at the Syracuse Hancock Airport when he collapsed -- he was in sudden cardiac arrest. item.title: MacKenzie-Childs co-founder dies
item.description: (WSYR-TV) -- Victoria MacKenzie-Childs, the co-founder of the iconic home decor brand MacKenzie-Childs, died Wednesday morning. She was 77. item.title: UPDATE: Arrest made in deadly shooting in Syracuse
item.description: A 26-year-old man died after suffering multiple gunshot wounds to his upper body in a home on Park Avenue late Thursday night, and Syracuse police are investigating the incident.

item.title: Syracuse icon returns home after being stuck in Dubai
item.description: Ralph Rotella, owner of Ralph's Shoe Repair in Syracuse, returned home after being stranded in Dubai due to flight cancellations caused by escalating conflict in Iran.
